headline: Canada’s Economy Stagnates for Second Month Ahead of September Contraction
summary: Canada’s economy stagnated for the second consecutive month as a contraction loomed for September.
why: Economic stagnation and output contractions in G7 economies can influence central bank rate expectations and currency valuations.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Prolonged stagnation signals slowing economic activity and potential headwinds for corporate earnings.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent economic stagnation highlights downside risks to national output, raising expectations for monetary easing.
